description: This file defines Kubernetes API types related to flow control, including FlowSchema, PriorityLevelConfiguration, and associated rules and conditions.

classes.name: FlowSchema
classes.description: Represents a schema for a group of API request flows, including metadata, specification, and status.

classes.name: FlowSchemaSpec
classes.description: Specifies how a FlowSchema is configured, including priority, rules, and distinguisher method.

classes.name: FlowDistinguisherMethod
classes.description: Defines how to compute the flow distinguisher for matching requests.

classes.name: PriorityLevelConfiguration
classes.description: Configures the priority level for request handling, including limits and exemption.

classes.name: PriorityLevelConfigurationSpec
classes.description: Specifies the configuration details for a priority level, including type and limits.

classes.name: FlowSchemaStatus
classes.description: Represents the current status of a FlowSchema, including conditions.

classes.name: FlowSchemaCondition
classes.description: Describes a specific condition of a FlowSchema, such as dangling or concurrency shared.

classes.name: Subject
classes.description: Represents the originator of a request, which can be a user, group, or service account.

classes.name: ResourcePolicyRule
classes.description: Defines rules for matching resource requests based on verbs, API groups, resources, and namespaces.

classes.name: NonResourcePolicyRule
classes.description: Defines rules for matching non-resource URL requests.
